WireScope 1.2.0

Prebuilt executable:
  dist/wirescope-linux-x86_64
  Linux x86-64 CLI frontend, Release build.

Qt GUI:
  The complete GUI source is included under gui/.
  Install Qt 6 Widgets and build with:
    sudo pacman -S --needed qt6-base
    cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DWIRESCOPE_BUILD_GUI=ON
    cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
  Launch:
    ./build/wirescope-gui

Live capture:
  The Linux GUI uses AF_PACKET raw sockets and requires CAP_NET_RAW.
  Apply the capability to the GUI binary after each rebuild:
    sudo setcap cap_net_raw+ep ./build/wirescope-gui

GUI enhancements in this package:
  - Follow TCP stream from packet and connection context menus / double-click.
  - Per-direction ASCII and hexadecimal payload views.
  - Connection time-range matching to disambiguate reused endpoint tuples.
  - Expanded packet protocol tree for IP, TCP, UDP, DNS, HTTP and TLS metadata.
  - Statistics dashboard with traffic timeline, protocol breakdown and top conversations.
